name: Kim Jae-won
bio: Kim Jae-won is a South Korean actor and model. He debuted as an actor in 2021.

credits.title: My Killer Crush
credits.overview: Do-young approaches Do-ha with a wild proposal – to help her plan the perfect accidental death – and together they form a secret pact. But as the two share chaos, laughter and secrets, an unexpected love develops.
